select 'TASK' as CD_TYPE, ID_TASK as ID_BIZ, ID_PROJECT, NAME_TASK as NAME_TITLE, CD_DESCRIPTION as CD_CONTENT, DT_CREATE from task where
and MATCH(NAME_TASK, CD_DESCRIPTION) AGAINST (CONCAT(#{keyword,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '*') IN BOOLEAN MODE) order by DT_CREATE desc limit #{limit}

select 'COMMENT' as CD_TYPE, c.ID_TASK as ID_BIZ, t.ID_PROJECT, t.NAME_TASK as NAME_TITLE, c.CD_COMMENT as CD_CONTENT, c.DT_COMMENT as DT_CREATE from task_comment c join task t on t.ID_TASK = c.ID_TASK where
and MATCH(c.CD_COMMENT) AGAINST (CONCAT(#{keyword,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '*') IN BOOLEAN MODE) order by c.DT_COMMENT desc limit #{limit}

select 'DOC' as CD_TYPE, ID_FILE as ID_BIZ, ID_PROJECT, NAME_FILE as NAME_TITLE, CD_COMMENT as CD_CONTENT, DT_UPLOAD as DT_CREATE from project_task_file where
and MATCH(NAME_FILE, CD_COMMENT) AGAINST (CONCAT(#{keyword,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '*') IN BOOLEAN MODE) order by DT_UPLOAD desc limit #{limit}

select 'TASK' as CD_TYPE, ID_TASK as ID_BIZ, ID_PROJECT, NAME_TASK as NAME_TITLE, CD_DESCRIPTION as CD_CONTENT, DT_CREATE from task where
and (NAME_TASK like concat('%', #{keyword,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%') or CD_DESCRIPTION like concat('%', #{keyword,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%')) order by DT_CREATE desc limit #{limit}

and c.CD_COMMENT like concat('%', #{keyword,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%') order by c.DT_COMMENT desc limit #{limit}
